findings.fix: Define default-src 'self' plus an explicit script-src without 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval'; use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.
Send 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' (or SAMEORIGIN if framing is required) and mirror it with CSP frame-ancestors.
Send 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' on every response, including error pages and static assets.
Send 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' (or no-referrer for maximum privacy).

findings.detail: Header absent - camera, mic, geolocation and friends are not gated
findings.fix: Send 'Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), interest-cohort=()' and explicitly allow-list only the APIs you use.
Send 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin' to isolate the browsing context from cross-origin popups/tabs.
Send 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin' (or same-site) to stop other origins from embedding your responses.

findings.detail: Modern best practice is to disable the legacy XSS auditor (value 0)
findings.fix: Modern browsers removed the XSS auditor; send 'X-XSS-Protection: 0' to avoid legacy filter-based XSS side channels.
Send 'Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp' to enable full cross-origin isolation alongside COOP.
Suppress or generalise the Server header (e.g. via reverse proxy) to avoid advertising exact software/version.
Disable or strip the X-Powered-By header at the framework/proxy level to reduce fingerprinting surface.
